import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_69/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length3_69/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city and type, aggregate average fare
grouped = joined.groupby(["city", "type"], as_index=False)["fare"].mean()

# Ensure column types match target schema
grouped["city"] = grouped["city"].astype(str)
grouped["type"] = grouped["type"].astype(str)
grouped["fare"] = grouped["fare"].astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
target = grouped[["city", "type", "fare"]]

# Write the result to the specified path without the index
target.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_69/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_69/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (primary key)

# Group by city and type (leftmost non-float unique attributes in target schema)
